translations.name: Interfaith Food Pantry of the Oranges
translations.description: Interfaith Food Pantry of the Oranges serves Orange, East Orange and West Orange, and has diapers. Walk in on Wednesdays 9am-12pm. It is closed the 1st Wednesday of each month. First-time visitors get a welcome bag. Call 973-856-4000.
translations.website_description: Learn how to get diapers and baby supplies.
